items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: This old Dave Faulk... he told me... this master

ctx.x: Who was this guy that Gershwin studied with.

This old Dave Faulk, or something like that and he told me, this man -- I would come down by there every night and this master -- see, there's a certain thing musicians about masters that you hear strains coming up you listen.
